prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the identity reference to preserve. Inputs 2 / 3 / 4 are installed room, original selective-ink art, Darkest Dungeon atmosphere reference. Produce a NEW authored view, not a flip, warp or pasted image. Only the requested object on genuine transparent background. Very broad quiet color planes, pooled black shadow masses, selective variable contour, almost no texture. Must look like a physical object in that room, not a bright collectible button. No matte, gradient, rimlight, shadow halo, extra props, borders or lettering. 
Draw a separately authored RIGHT SIDE view of exactly this iron safe and its single supporting slab. Camera is 75 degrees around its right side, still human eye height with modest top-plane visibility. Keep the same physical RIGHTWARD tilt, same one iron strap/latch and coins only a tiny gap. Front latch should be strongly foreshortened at LEFT edge of the visible box. Stone slab supports the same physical corner; not a flat symmetrical pedestal. Preserve simplified dull grey metal, very few chips, muted coins. No hanging purse or text.
